title: Lags before the solve
heading: Trap Questions: Rows That Look Right and Are Not
cases: a finish-to-start lag becomes start-to-start by adding the parent's duration, and a start-to-start lag stays as it is
a child year that no parent start can serve is removed from the window
a finish-to-finish lag adds the parent's duration and subtracts the child's
a start-to-finish lag subtracts the child's duration
with a lag of zero the child may start in the parent's start year
a child year is kept when any one of the parent's possible start years serves it
